messages:
Joanne: :wave: Hi team — kickoff for Veridian Labs onboarding. Want to align stakeholders, success criteria, timelines, and renewal risk mitigation. Proposed kickoff Wed Apr 7 10:00am PT. Dana (Veridian CTO) and Marco (ML) will join. Rajesh, can you confirm capacity/pricing lead?

Rajesh: Confirmed. I’ll own capacity + pricing. Renewal window is June '26 so we should prioritize a short pilot and clear success gates. I suggest a 6-week pilot with Dedicated trial option.

Linus: I’ll take integrations. Need sample prompts, expected qps, and S3 access to a small sample dataset. Prefer a presigned link or a service account with read-only access. Tagging eng-oncall for any infra questions.

Sara: Draft success criteria ideas:
- p95 latency <250ms for typical inference paths
- >98% availability for pilot traffic
- Quality regression <5% on our eval prompt set
- Two enablement sessions + docs for Veridian devs
- Clear handoff docs and runbook

Joanne: Love that. Draft timeline suggestion: 
```
Week 0: Kickoff + access + stakeholder alignment
Week 1-2: Integration + sample tests + model selection
Week 3: Perf tuning + quant tests + caching setup
Week 4: Pilot run (steady traffic) + observability tuning
Week 5: Feedback + iterate on prompts/config
Week 6: Success review + handoff + renewal playbook
```

Rajesh: I’ll send the calendar invite and include legal/ops. Contract shows NDA signed. Will add a renewal checkpoint in Week 5.

Linus: I’ll upload an integration checklist and a prompt template by EOD tomorrow. Will also add the minimal env vars and a sample curl snippet:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/predict \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' \
  -d '{"model":"open-llm-v1","inputs":"<sample>"}'
```

Joanne: Action items (owners):
- Rajesh: schedule kickoff + include legal/ops + send calendar link
- Linus: post integration checklist + sample prompts + curl examples
- Sara: build dashboard template for success metrics (latency/cost/quality)
- Joanne: stakeholder comms, weekly sync agenda, capture feedback plan

Joanne: Any immediate blockers? :eyes:

Rajesh: No blockers from AE side. We should confirm whether they want Dedicated or Hosted for pilot.

Linus: Blocker: Veridian needs to create a service account with read access to sample bucket by Friday, otherwise we delay integration.

Joanne: I'll follow up with Dana and Priya for access and ask Marco for expected qps and prompt distribution.

onboarding-bot: Calendar event created: "Veridian Labs Onboarding Kickoff" Wed Apr 7 10:00am PT — invite includes Joanne, Rajesh, Linus, Sara.

Joanne: Thanks everyone — I'll post the invite link once I see Rajesh's calendar item. Next sync after kickoff: weekly Thursday 9:30am PT. :rocket:
